stories.title: Buffalo Elementary School of Technology student falls from second-story window
stories.summary: BPS says an elementary student fell from a second story window on Wednesday. The teacher and teacher aide have both been placed on paid administrative leave.

stories.title: 'Turning pain into purpose': Buffalo mothers lead effort to create 1,000-face memorial quilt
stories.summary: Organizers working to create a quilt with 1,000 faces of Western New Yorkers who had untimely deaths.

stories.title: Amherst clears hurdle in Boulevard Mall Redevelopment Plan
stories.summary: State Supreme Court Justice Raymond Walter has authorized Amherst to acquire vacant parts of the Boulevard Mall site through eminent domain.

stories.title: Motorcyclist injured following crash on Route 33 Thursday
stories.summary: Once at the scene, officers located a motorcyclist with significant leg injuries. The victim was brought to ECMC for treatment.

stories.title: 76-year-old hurt in Amherst e-bike crash
stories.summary: Police say the man suffered serious injuries to his chest and head. He was treated at the scene before being transported to ECMC

stories.title: State police: Head-on crash in Cattaraugus County leaves 1 dead
stories.summary: State police say a head-on crash in Cattaraugus County left one person dead after a pickup truck crossed the center line on Olean Portville Road.

stories.title: Buffalo woman accused of possessing large quantities of fentanyl, cocaine
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors say a 48-year-old woman faces charges after an investigation into fentanyl and cocaine.

stories.title: NYSDEC charges man accused of using dead father's hunting license
stories.summary: DEC Officials say a deer tag claimed a nine-point buck was killed by an 83-year-old hunter. However, the signature was a different name from the designated hunter.

stories.title: Niagara Falls Police creates anonymous tip line
stories.summary: Residents will be able to submit tips directly to law enforcement without having to identify themselves.

stories.title: Buffalo teacher injured breaking up school fight; police recover knife
stories.summary: A Buffalo teacher was injured while trying to break up a school fight that spilled onto Chippewa Street. Police said they also recovered a knife at the scene.

stories.title: Buffalo school board rejects district school closure plan in 5-3-1 vote
stories.summary: A controversial plan to close and consolidate multiple Buffalo schools will not move forward after the Buffalo Board of Education voted it down Wednesday night.

stories.title: Unloaded gun found in student's bookbag at Buffalo high school after slipping past security screening system
stories.summary: Buffalo Public Schools and Buffalo Police are investigating after an unloaded firearm was discovered in a student's backpack.
